title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Mixtures and Alligations
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: A mixture contains lemon juice and sugar syrup in equal proportion. If a new mixture is created by adding this mixture and sugar syrup in the ratio 1 : 3, then the ratio of lemon juice and sugar syrup in the new mixture is
questions.explain: Let the first mixture be 1 kg, having 0.5 kg lemon juice and 0.5 kg sugar syrup. We add 3 kg of sugar syrup to it. Total lemon juice = 0.5 kg. Total sugar syrup = 0.5 + 3 = 3.5 kg. Ratio of lemon juice to sugar syrup = $0.5 : 3.5 = 1 : 7$.
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability
